candidates_considered.verdict: RESEARCHED, NOT PUBLISHED - today's filing re-announces an order the company already disclosed in August. Read: the 09-Oct press release, the 05-Aug LoA intimation, the full 240-day announcement list (69 rows, read status complete) and the BSE detailed results. The 09-Oct filing is the signing of the Contract Agreement for SAIL-ISP Burnpur Pellet Plant Package-2 at Rs 854.57 cr - and it says in its own words that the signing 'follows the Letter of Acceptance received by the Company from SAIL-ISP in August 2026'. So the order is two months old and the number is unchanged; the new facts are a signing ceremony and a consolidated order book 'crosses Rs 10,000 crore'. Against sales the order is large - 156% of FY26 standalone revenue of Rs 547.75 cr - but on rarity SEPC is the opposite of the profile the 1,245-filing study rewards: at least five order/LoA announcements in the 240 days read alone (05-Aug SAIL Rs 854.57 cr, 12-Jun SAIL LoA press-released 15-Jun at Rs 673 cr, 23-Feb) and the bucket with eight or more prior filings reached 2x 17.3% of the time and 5x never. Three further measured reasons not to publish: (1) TWO orders were CANCELLED inside the same window - a TCIL order (update filed 07-Aug) and an EPC sub-contract of the SEPC-Furlong joint operation (11-Jul, following a 14-May intimation); (2) promoter holding has collapsed from 27.35% (Sep-2025 filing) to 27.15%, 18.67% and 11.67% (Jun-2026 filing) while the company allotted up to 153 crore equity shares preferentially to acquire 90% of UAE-based Avenir; (3) the P&L has turned - Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 118.85 cr with a PAT LOSS of Rs 18.17 cr, FY26 revenue Rs 547.75 cr DOWN from Rs 597.65 cr, BSE header EPS -0.02, PE -264.50, ROE -0.29. data_problems: LOUD, for the owner: score.py is MIS-SCORING a published card. BHAGYANGR's copper business demerged into Tieramet Limited with record date 08-Oct-2026, and the BSE close went Rs 453.95 (07-Oct) -> Rs 41.40 (08-Oct), a 10.96x one-day gap, measured from scripts/ideas/_cache/bhav_20261007.csv and bhav_20261008.csv in this run. score.py's unrecorded-corporate-action rule snapped that gap to a SPLIT FACTOR OF 11 (track.json -> adj_events: ['2026-10-08 x11 unrecorded gap x10.96']) and divided the pre-08-Oct history by 11, restating the card's call close from the true Rs 444.90 of 23-Sep-2026 to Rs 40.45 and reporting ret_pct +7.4%. A demerger is not a split: value left the company, it was not subdivided. The honest position of a holder from the call is one BIL share at Rs 43.45 PLUS one Tieramet share of Rs 2 face value that has not begun trading, so the return is NOT MEASURABLE until Tieramet lists. ideas.json's own call_close of Rs 444.90 is unchanged and correct - only the scorecard row is wrong. This routine is not permitted to edit scripts/ideas/*.py, so the defect is reported, not fixed, and a full update has been written onto the BHAGYANGR card so a reader of the page sees the warning beside the +7.4%. The same rule will mis-handle any future demerger ex-date.
